commands.name: create
commands.summary: mint a passport document (core skeleton + empty log) as JSON

commands.name: event
commands.summary: append a typed event to a passport's log (optionally Ed25519-signed)

commands.name: pack
commands.summary: mint the Tier-A offline pack from a passport (optionally signed)

commands.name: verify
commands.summary: unpack a pack, check it, and print the graded verdict

commands.name: resolve
commands.summary: normalize a scanned carrier (GS1 DL / GB/T 33993 / EAN-13 / URN)

commands.name: grid
commands.summary: run the two-segment grid demonstration (spine, route, coverage)

commands.name: dossier
commands.summary: verify a dossier offline, with zero calls to foreign systems

commands.name: conform
commands.summary: run a conformance-class claim test on public material
